SELECT
    rm.risk_margin_profile -> 'margin_thresholds' ->> 'inithold' AS risk_profile_id,
    o.recordvault AS related_order,
    ab.accountbalancesnode AS account_balance_id,
    rm.risk_margin_profile -> 'margin_rates' ->> 'margrate' AS margin_requirement,
    ab.margsum AS margin_balance,
    rm.risk_margin_profile -> 'collateral' ->> 'collsum' AS margin_usage

    riskandmargin rm

    orders o ON rm.ordervault = o.recordvault
JOIN
    accountbalances ab ON o.userlink = ab.usertag;

SELECT
    rm.risk_margin_profile -> 'margin_thresholds' ->> 'inithold' AS risk_profile_id,
    o.recordvault AS related_order,
    ab.accountbalancesnode AS account_balance_id,
    rm.risk_margin_profile -> 'margin_rates' ->> 'margrate' AS margin_requirement,
    ab.margsum AS margin_balance,
    rm.risk_margin_profile -> 'collateral' ->> 'collsum' AS margin_usage
FROM
    riskandmargin rm
JOIN
    orders o ON rm.ordervault = o.recordvault
JOIN
    accountbalances ab ON o.userlink = ab.usertag;
